rationale: Houthis tighten Red Sea grip continues to threaten Atlantic shipping and energy costs; Saudi pipeline shutdown adds fuel price pressure; France train derailment is a western EU incident.

top_events.title: Houthis claim major advance in Yemen and tighten grip on Red Sea shipping lane
top_events.label: Houthis seize Perim island Red Sea route
top_events.summary: Iran-backed Houthis capture strategic Perim island on major shipping lane, escalating threat to Atlantic-bound cargo and EU energy supplies.

top_events.title: Satellite image shows critical Saudi pipeline damaged in drone attack
top_events.label: Saudi oil pipeline shut after drone strike
top_events.summary: Saudi Arabia shuts East-West oil pipeline following drone attack from Iraq, adding pressure on global energy markets and Portuguese fuel costs.

top_events.title: Passenger train derails in France leaving at least 44 injured
top_events.label: France train derails Normandy injuring 44
top_events.summary: Train operating Rouen-Caen route derails in Normandy with 180 passengers aboard, injuring 44; western EU transport incident.

short_summary: Houthis seize Mokha port near key strait

most_significant_event.label: Houthis seize Mokha port near key strait
most_significant_event.summary: Capture brings Iran-backed group closer to controlling Bab al-Mandab Strait, a vital shipping route for Atlantic-connected energy and goods, raising supply chain risks for Portugal.
most_significant_event.title: Yemen's Houthis reportedly seize strategic Red Sea port of Mokha
